posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body: Estrogen and progesterone influence brain chemistry, bone density, cardiovascular health, and immune function.
posts.cta: Your hormones control far more than reproduction.

posts.headline: Tip
posts.body:
Sunlight in the morning sets your circadian rhythm and boosts serotonin.
10–15 minutes outside within 1 hour of waking.
posts.cta: Morning sunlight is the best free health hack.
